libusb.name: libusb

spooler.name: Windows
spooler.detail: Prints through the printer installed in Windows, in RAW mode.

device.name: Direct USB
device.detail: Prints straight to the Windows USB device, with no printer installed.
device.recommendation: It works, but installing the printer in Windows is recommended (Settings › Printers & scanners › Add, port USB001, driver “Generic / Text Only”). Windows then handles the queue and paper or connection errors.
